plates.title: Thorn Triangle
plates.description: Unequal flowering shoots, rolled leaves and papyrus clumps trace three triangular edges.

plates.title: Pollen Eclipse
plates.description: A tangential botanical garland bends around displaced oval interference; flowering shoots cross its center.

plates.title: Feral Arch
plates.description: Nested, drifting arches stand on branching cannabis columns with papyrus keystones.

plates.title: Diamond Cage
plates.description: Two skewed woven lattices trap an overgrown diamond of fan leaves and papyrus.

plates.title: Hexagonal Spore
plates.description: Six whole branching specimens radiate outward from an irregular central root ring across fivefold guilloche.

plates.title: Serpentine Frieze
plates.description: Uneven flowering shoots and papyrus braces lean into a chirped ribbon from opposing botanical borders.

plates.title: Double Arch Mirage
plates.description: Opposing arches frame two unequal hanging and upright thickets with mixed stages, heights and lean.

plates.title: Fractured Compass
plates.description: Nine unequal branching spokes erupt outward: flowering axes, broad foliage and paired papyrus crowns.

plates.title: Orbital Herbarium
plates.description: Tilted ovals pass through a five-plant flowering stand and five papyrus culms.

plates.title: Overgrown Cathedral
plates.description: An asymmetric forest erupts through dense nested arches, triangular guilloche and ornamental side borders.
